ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of the material cycle of the lithosphere; the bottom box is "magma", the upper box is "igneous rock", the left box is "metamorphic rock", and the right box is "sedimentary rock". The label ① in the figure appears beside the arrows pointing from igneous rock, metamorphic rock, and sedimentary rock to "magma" at the bottom. Then reason: for various types of rocks to transform into magma, they need to be melted under high-temperature conditions; therefore label ① represents the melting process by which rocks become magma. Final answer: melting.
